name: scdaw_export_midi
description: Exports the active song or track notes as a Standard MIDI File (.mid) Format 1 (multi-track) or Format 0 (single track), baking active MIDI FX and swing.

format.description: SMF format: 1 (multi-track, default) or 0 (single track merged)

loops.description: Number of pattern repetitions to export (default 1)

bakeMidiFx.description: Whether to bake arpeggiator/pitch/velocity MIDI FX into notes (default true)

bakeSwing.description: Whether to bake 16th-note swing timing offsets into notes (default true)

saveToWorkspace.description: Whether to trigger browser download of .mid file
